_comment_ConnectionStrings: Development placeholder. Override via ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection env var in all non-local environments.
_comment_Firmware: Directory holding the court-box firmware this image offers over the air (court_bridge.signed.bin + firmware.manifest.json, or a README when the build was unsigned). Served anonymously at /firmware/ and read by OtaCatalogue when no Ota:Stable:* is configured. Left empty it resolves to /app/firmware when that exists (the Docker image, where the Dockerfile bakes CI's iot-sign artifact) and otherwise to the repository's firmware-payload/ three levels above this project (a developer checkout). A relative path resolves against the API content root. Override with Firmware__PayloadPath.

Tenancy._comment: ResolveFrom: 'host' = subdomain (foo.example.com), 'header' = X-Tenant header, 'jwt' = JWT claim. Default chain: jwt then host.

_comment_Devices: Development placeholder. Override via DEVICE_MASTER_KEY in all non-local environments. Root of every device credential.
_comment_RateLimits: Per-minute ceilings. Deployment infrastructure rather than club policy, so these live here and not in tenant_settings: the limiter runs before tenant resolution and partitions by the client address the gateway forwarded (or by the authenticated member for the auth policy), neither of which is a tenant-scoped quantity. Firmware bounds the anonymous OTA download per address.
_comment_Gateway: Proxies whose X-Forwarded-For / -Proto / -Host headers the API believes. Addresses or CIDR networks. Default: loopback plus the docker bridge pools, which is where the compose gateway container stands in both compose files.
_comment_Discovery: UDP board-discovery listener. Deployment infrastructure, not club policy, so it lives here rather than in tenant_settings: the listener binds before any request exists (so there is no tenant to read a setting from), the boards it hears belong to no tenant yet, and the ceilings bound an unauthenticated UDP socket. Port 48653 is fixed by the wire protocol; AdvertisedBaseUrl left empty means the OFFER carries the address of whichever local interface can reach the board. Requires host networking - see docker-compose.onprem.yml.
_comment_Webhooks: SSRF guard. AllowPrivateNetworks disables it wholesale and defaults to true only in Development. PrivateNetworkAllowList is the carve-out CLAUDE.md requires for the lights controller: CIDRs, so a /32 admits one board rather than the whole private internet.
